title: A Unified FIDE, Chess.com, and Lichess Database: Analyzing Elite Chess Players and their Behavioral Patterns
description: Data pipeline, unified player database, and analysis code for a master's project that links official FIDE identities to Chess.com and Lichess accounts to study behavioral patterns in elite online chess. Includes the scraping and unification code, the derived player and game-level datasets, and the analysis scripts and figures.
